products.name: CarpuTech 14.4-inch Qualcomm Tesla-Style Android 13 Screen for Chevrolet Silverado / GMC Sierra 2014-2018, Wireless CarPlay, 4 GB / 64 GB
specs: 14.4-inch vertical touchscreen (15.6-inch option is $1,099.99); resolution not stated
4 GB RAM / 64 GB storage (8 GB / 128 GB is $1,099.99)
OnStar, Bose amplifier, SiriusXM (per listing); backup camera and climate controls not stated
Chevrolet Silverado / GMC Sierra 1500, 2500, 3500, 2014-2018 (the compatibility list also names 2019)
4G LTE SIM slot, Wi-Fi, phone hotspot
Free; 1-2 working days to process, 3-10 working days to deliver; origin not stated
products.warranty: 2 years on Android screens: defects in the first 60 days get a replacement or refund with CarpuTech paying return shipping; days 61 to 730 get a repair or a discounted replacement.
products.returns: Non-defect returns within 30 days of delivery; buyer pays return shipping and a 19% restocking fee if uninstalled (29-39% if installed), plus the original shipping cost.
products.summary: A 14.4-inch Tesla-style Android 13 head unit for 2014-2018 Silverado and Sierra trucks on a Snapdragon 665 with wireless CarPlay and Android Auto. It keeps OnStar, the Bose amp and SiriusXM, and it is the only unit in its price group sold with a 2-year warranty.
products.fit: Owners of a 2014-2018 Silverado or Sierra who want a Snapdragon unit under $1,000 and value a 2-year warranty over a bigger spec sheet.
caveats: The product page shows no customer reviews yet, and CarpuTech's Trustpilot score is 2.8 out of 5 from a handful of reviews.
The listing warns that the factory radio's CD player and AUX input must work, because Android audio plays through the AUX channel.
The page title says 15.6-inch while the URL says 14.4-inch; the size is chosen in the variant picker, and the 15.6-inch version costs $100 more.
The listing does not say whether the factory backup camera or climate controls carry over to the new screen; ask support before ordering.
Non-defect returns carry a 19% restocking fee and the buyer pays return shipping.

products.summary: A 15.6-inch Tesla-style Android 13 head unit for 2019-2023 Silverado and Sierra trucks with 7-inch or 8-inch factory screens, on a Snapdragon 665, with a 2-year warranty.
products.fit: Owners of a 2019-2023 Silverado or Sierra with the 7-inch or 8-inch factory screen who want a Snapdragon unit with a 2-year warranty.

The listing does not state the screen resolution or whether OnStar, Bose or climate controls carry over.
No customer reviews on the product page yet.
Non-defect returns carry a 19% restocking fee and the buyer pays return shipping.
